sn45.76:1.1: ekadhammo bhikkhave, bahukāro ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya. katamo ekadhammo: yadidaṃ yonisomanasikārasampadā.
sn45.76:1.2: yonisomanasikārasampannassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ. ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.
sn45.76:1.3: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno. ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.76:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.
sn45.76:1.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
